title: Basket with the most distinct products
statementMd:
Which order contains the most distinct products? Show order id and the count (no tie).

Expected columns: `order_id`, `products`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS products FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY products DESC, order_id LIMIT 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
